subject.title: improve(ci): preserve complete main validation during merge bursts

question: Can a maintainer with protected GitHub and Blacksmith access verify the no-role-bypass `openclaw/ci-gate` ruleset and provide a redacted A/B protected-main run after the checkout race is fixed?
rationale: The required ruleset and real concurrency behavior are external operational controls, so they cannot be established from this branch’s workflow guard tests alone.

options.title: Fix and validate the protected path
options.body: Pin the cache-warmer checkout to the triggering SHA, then show a protected-main merge-burst trace and ruleset state before merge.

options.title: Pause the rollout
options.body: Keep the existing CI policy until the protected ruleset and after-fix operational behavior can be verified.

recommendation.title: Fix and validate the protected path
recommendation.body: Pin the cache-warmer checkout to the triggering SHA, then show a protected-main merge-burst trace and ruleset state before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged and proposed work places this person closest to the cache-writer and CI concurrency design.
